notes: Version 2.52 records white paper 3.17, Q6a 2.7 and O18 2.1. White-paper Proposition A.1 is restated: for a fixed principal connection over a connected base, trivial holonomy is equivalent to a global horizontal section, so any nontrivial holonomy, of any dimension, excludes such a section. Nontrivial holonomy does not make the bundle topologically nontrivial, and trivial holonomy does not exclude gauge transformations: a trivial bundle can carry a connection with full U(1) holonomy, and the product connection on a trivial bundle has trivial holonomy and still admits nontrivial gauge transformations. Appendix B.23 and the two O18 motivation passages now ground the exclusion of fibre gauge structure under injectivity on injectivity itself, in the principal-bundle setting; the Q6a remark no longer presents nontrivial holonomy as a condition for gauge symmetry and no longer attributes to the white paper a non-contractible loop. Proposition 5.3 and Theorem A.1 are unchanged. No paper status, graph node or edge changes.
